encounters.weakness: Lava Resonance Core (acquired from Encounter 0) — must be used to overload the enemy's internal harmonic core
Vulnerable to sustained flame. Its ash-carapace hardens under cold or wind, but continuous fire melts it. Once melted, its core is exposed for 5 seconds.
Its core is encased in cooled lava. Only sustained flame (enabled by Ignition Surge) can keep it molten long enough to expose the unstable geode inside for 4 seconds.
Immune to direct flame. Only the Lava Shard — once embedded in its spectral form — can anchor it to the material plane. Once anchored, its core becomes vulnerable to any flame attack for 8 seconds.
Resonant Frequency (from Arcane Resonator — revealed after first encounter)

Vulnerable to Stormcaller's Chain Lightning after absorbing the first Lava-Siphon Core. The core disrupts its obsidian-carapace resonance, causing its limbs to vibrate out of sync — chain lightning now arcs between its joints.

Vulnerable to Chain Lightning only when Lava-Siphon Core #1 is active AND Core #2 is absorbed. The combined resonance overloads its soul-flame, causing it to phase erratically — lightning can now chain between its two spectral forms.

Vulnerable to Chain Lightning only when both Lava-Siphon Cores #1 and #2 are active AND Core #3 is absorbed. The triple resonance creates harmonic feedback in its magma spine — lightning now resonates with its internal rhythm, causing it to collapse under its own weight for 4 seconds.
Vulnerable to Chrono-Slow — the base ability of the Chronomancer's Time-Weave Staff. When slowed, its molten core crystallizes, causing it to shatter.
Vulnerable to Chrono-Reversal — the Echo Shard's ability. When reversed, its crystalline armor reverts to molten state, causing it to destabilize and collapse.

Vulnerable to Chrono-Slow + Chrono-Reversal combo. Slowing its molten tendrils lets the player reverse the flow of time around them, causing the tendrils to retract into its core, exposing its heartbeat.
Chrono-Anchor — must be used to freeze one of the three temporal threads it weaves, exposing its core
Shattered Hourglass Fragment — must be used during its 'Temporal Drain' phase to reverse its absorption of the player's time, causing feedback damage
Storm Surge — must be used in rapid succession (3x within 1.5s) to shatter its ethereal form
Echoed Thunder — the 3-sequence Storm Surge must strike its three exposed plasma nodes simultaneously
Prismatic Shard — must reflect its own Chaos Bolt back into its core using the Shard's refraction during its channeling phase

Dissonance Grenades — obtained from defeating the Whispering Nebulae — disrupt its auditory resonance. Each grenade detonates in a 5m sphere, silencing its whispers and reducing its movement speed by 70% for 8 seconds. If three grenades are used consecutively, the enemy collapses, dropping the first Harmonic Shard.

The Dissonance Grenades (from Encounter 0) destabilize the Loom's gravity field. When detonated near its core, the grenades create temporary micro-singularities that pull the Loom off-balance, exposing its core for 4 seconds. Three consecutive destabilizations cause the Loom to fracture, dropping the second Harmonic Shard.

The Gravity Anchor (from Encounter 1) can be fired as a projectile to latch onto the Wraith's spectral form. When latched, it anchors the Wraith in place for 6 seconds — during which, the Artificer can fire Dissonance Grenades directly into its core. Two successful latches + grenade detonations collapse its form, revealing the third Harmonic Shard.
